name: Fernleaf phacelia
desc: Fernleaf phacelia (Phacelia bipinnatifida): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 21 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Phacelia bipinnatifida, commonly known as purple phacelia, fernleaf phacelia and spotted phacelia is a species of phacelia native to the southeastern United States.
